evidence: Static bytecode review (CFR 0.152 of individual classes read from the jar; case-sensitive class names such as ci/CI and kI/ki collide in the unpacked tree). No C-Gate command was executed and no bus, network or radio I/O was performed.
command_encoding: aW.c(int): two uppercase hex digits, values above 0xFF render as FF. The strings below are the aW.e command bodies before PCI framing and checksum.

actions.reply: IDENTIFY reply of exactly 8 bytes; each byte replaces CBusWirelessUnit.an[i] and a change fires D()
actions.failure: Ci(false) when the reply is missing or not 8 bytes
actions.why_live: IDENTIFY attribute 0xFE is answered only by the physical wireless unit; the database holds no MAI value

actions.reply: none (ci.k=false, ci.i=0); success means the send completed
actions.why_live: The CAL 0x08 command resets counters held in the physical unit

actions.source: CBusWirelessUnit$RecallOpStatsExposer -> CBusNGUnit.a(aX, 0, 48, false) -> bp.a(unit, address, count<=12)
actions.reply: bp accepts replies starting with hex(128+count+1)+hex(address); 48 bytes become twelve little-endian 32-bit counters exposed by the OpStats property
actions.failure: Ci('Op stats recall failed') when any chunk is missing or short
actions.why_live: The counters live in the physical unit's memory, outside the PP database image

actions.source: CBusWirelessUnit cached Cn string properties with null read callbacks; constructor defaults unknown. Physical refresh is separately CBusWirelessUnit.n(aX)->u(aX)->bB.q/r/s/t during Psync.
actions.reply: GET returns cached strings (initially unknown). The separate physical refresh reads text fields of 3, 6, 4 and 4 bytes; failures reset the affected cache to unknown.
actions.why_live: Cached GET has no physical I/O. Fresh readings require a separate explicit Psync physical operation; GET does not establish freshness.

actions.argument_rules: app 0..255, group 0..255; grade <= 0, 3..127 or > 131 is a syntax error; access level Cb(4)
actions.reply: none (bC.i=0); 200 OK even after a 408 'Learn command failed' line
actions.why_live: The broadcast puts the network's wireless units into or out of learn mode; pairing results exist only on the radio network and in unit memory
